coverage_guards.reason: A section is named by the glob exactly as it was written. The glob is not expanded and not matched against anything, so [*.{js,ts}], [lib/**.py] and [[0-9]*.txt] are each one declaration under one name; which files a section actually governs must be asked of a glob evaluator, not of this index.

EditorConfig is resolved as a cascade: a tool walks up from the edited file applying every .editorconfig it meets until one says root = true, and within a file a later matching section overrides an earlier one. This Pack states what one file declares. The effective settings for a given path are the result of that cascade and are not computed here.

A key is stored lowercased, as the specification defines keys to be case-insensitive, so Indent_Style and indent_style are one declaration. The value is stored trimmed and otherwise as authored: it is not lowercased, unset is stored as the word unset rather than as a removal, and a value the reading tool does not understand is stored all the same.
